description: Round and rectangular duct size from airflow and your friction rate or velocity limit, rounded up to a size you can buy with velocity and friction recomputed, what a duct carries, and a reducing trunk sized after each branch. Estimate only; confirm with your plans, supplier and local code.

b1.description: Branch 1 airflow. Optional. Shown on the site only when "mode=trunk" is set.

b2.description: Branch 2 airflow. Optional. Shown on the site only when "mode=trunk" is set.

b3.description: Branch 3 airflow. Optional. Shown on the site only when "mode=trunk" is set.

b4.description: Branch 4 airflow. Optional. Shown on the site only when "mode=trunk" is set.

b5.description: Branch 5 airflow. Optional. Shown on the site only when "mode=trunk" is set.

b6.description: Branch 6 airflow. Optional. Shown on the site only when "mode=trunk" is set.

capA.description: Diameter or width. Unit: in (imperial) or mm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 304.8. Shown on the site only when "mode=capacity" is set.

capB.description: Height. Unit: in (imperial) or mm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Optional. Shown on the site only when "mode=capacity" is set.

cfm.description: Airflow. Shown on the site only when "mode=size" is set.

eps.description: Absolute roughness of the duct material, in ft, from the duct maker or your design reference. No default: without it no size is given.

height.description: Rectangular height. Unit: in (imperial) or mm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Optional. Shown on the site only when "mode=size" is set.

rate.description: Friction rate. Shown on the site only when "method=friction" is set.

run.description: Straight run. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Optional. Shown on the site only when "mode=size" is set.

system.description: Unit system the inputs are typed in and the defaults are taken from.

trunkCfm.description: Trunk airflow. Shown on the site only when "mode=trunk" is set.

trunkHeight.description: Trunk height. Unit: in (imperial) or mm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Optional. Shown on the site only when "mode=trunk" is set.

vmax.description: Maximum velocity. Shown on the site only when "method=velocity" is set.
